req_desc: The product ships a public marketing estate of sixteen routes ...
A `requester` reads only the requests raised by that same account ...
Every seeded account signs in with the password `deku-demo-pw-2026` ...
The console work surface is a split detail pane beside the board columns ...
A drag succeeds only where a transition joins the two statuses ...
A successful transition writes the new status, appending one history entry ...
A transition attempted by a `requester` is denied
Two simultaneous drags of one card yield exactly one written move
Reordering one card changes the rank of that one card alone
The card enters its new column before the write is confirmed ...
A transition carries conditions, validators, post-functions as three hooks
Publishing a workflow is refused until every removed status names a destination
A project created with no configuration gets three statuses, no conditions
An automation rule names one trigger transition, one actor, one action
A rule action appears in history attributed to its actor, marked automated
A rule already in the chain does not fire again for that work item
One rule execution meters one unit regardless of actions taken ...
An assignee change by a rule sends one email over real SMTP
The subject begins `Northwind work update:` then the item key
No email is sent where the assignee is unchanged
A member is denied another project board plus every listing drawn from that board ...
Every count is computed over the asking account's own visible set
Only an `admin` reads the page-view log, a member being denied ...
A shared saved filter resolves as the reader rather than its owner
An unknown query field name is refused with the offending token named
One signup submission produces one of three named outcomes
An invalid form entry is rejected in place, naming its own field
Accept, reject, manage carry equal visual strength in the consent dialogue
Changing team size recomputes every figure with no network request
Graduated bands charge the users in each band at that band's rate
Above ten users the Free column reads `Not available above 10 users`
The saving badge reads `SAVE UP TO 17%`
The catalogue combines product, team, type facets ...
A customer story carries `Challenge:`, `Solution:`, `Impact:` as three fields
A terms page is reachable from every footer, linked from signup
An unknown address answers with a not-found status of its own
Every route in the route table exists, reachable without client-side scripting ...
An unauthenticated console request lands on the sign-in route ...
The pricing journey restores both controls from the address
The catalogue journey opens the same view from a shared address
Every list carries an empty state naming what would fill the list ...
The estate carries atmosphere, the console reading quiet, dense, organised ...
The frontend is `React` with `Vite`, the backend `Flask` ...
Sixteen tables carry the model, every timestamp being UTC ...
Three projects are seeded: `FIN`, `MKT`, `SUP` ...
Every visual value resolves from a named token, never a literal colour ...
Motion binds to four named roles used in component code ...
Every icon is drawn as geometry, never fetched as a separate request ...
A solid blue square bleeds to the viewport corner on product routes ...
One mega-menu panel slides beneath whichever trigger opened the panel ...
Customer marks are silhouettes tinted per section ...
The pricing plan table carries a ribbon reading `RECOMMENDED` across its third column
The work product route places a signup card beside its headline
The home journey pins a stage across reserved scroll distance ...
No real-time collaborative editing ships ...
The app is reachable at `APP_PUBLIC_URL` ...
Every list endpoint returns a top-level JSON array
core asks covered by this grader
